title: NRE, NRO and FCNR concepts - explained
content: NRE, NRO and FCNR are account or deposit categories used in Indian non-resident banking, with different purposes and currency features. Eligibility, permitted credits, taxation and repatriation depend on applicable rules and circumstances.
